systems.name: 3.1 Weapon Mods & Attachments
systems.notes: Introduce weapon modifiers that change behavior: ricochet rounds, explosive bullets, freezing beams, poison darts. Mods drop as rare loot and can be applied in the shop.
tasks: Design 8 weapon mods with VFX and SFX
Mod inventory and application UI in armory
Balance damage and effect duration per mod
Synergy system where mods combine (ricochet + explosive = cluster mines)

systems.name: 3.2 Powerup Evolutions & Synergies
systems.notes: Powerups can stack or evolve: double nuke, blade barrier, monkey squad. Collecting the same powerup while active refreshes and upgrades its tier.
tasks: Implement powerup tier system (I, II, III)
Visual scale-up and additional effects per tier
Prevent duplicate powerup drops when max tier reached

systems.name: 3.3 Trinkets & Passive Upgrades
systems.notes: Expand trinket variety: dodge chance, life leech, bonus score, auto-collect radius, slow aura. Add rarity tiers (common, rare, legendary) with stat scaling.
tasks: Design 12 new trinket types with unique icons
Rarity tier system affecting stat rolls
Set bonuses for equipping trinkets of same theme
